title: HackUNIVO 2026: 36-Hour National Hackathon
venue: Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Auditorium & CS Labs
shortDescription: UNIVO's flagship 36-hour hackathon bringing together 200+ developers, designers, and innovators with ₹1,50,000 in cash prizes.
description: Join over 200 passionate student developers, engineers, and designers in UNIVO's premier 36-hour national collegiate hackathon. Build innovative software prototypes spanning Generative AI, Web3/DeFi, Sustainable Smart Cities, and HealthTech. Receive 1-on-1 mentorship from top engineering leaders at Microsoft, Google, and unicorn startups, plus access to cloud credits, delicious meals, and swag bags.

agenda.title: Midnight Pizza, Red Bull & Esports Mini-tournament
Final Top 10 Stage Demos to Jury

eligibility: Open to all enrolled undergraduate and postgraduate students in teams of 2 to 4 members.
prerequisites: Bring your personal laptop, charger, student ID card, and enthusiasm to build.
coordinator: Dr. Arvind Mehta (Faculty Advisor) & Aryan Sharma (Student Lead)

title: Production GenAI Apps with Google Gemini
shortDescription: Hands-on masterclass on building scalable multimodal GenAI applications using Gemini APIs and structured outputs.
description: Learn to architect end-to-end AI applications using Google's latest Gemini 3.8 and Flash models. This hands-on developer session covers prompt engineering techniques, function calling, multimodal audio/vision analysis, and building stateful conversational interfaces using the Google GenAI SDK.

agenda.title: Welcome & Large Multimodal Models Architecture Overview
Prompt Crafting, Function Calling & Structured JSON Extraction
Live Coding Lab: Deploying a Context-Aware Campus Assistant
Q&A, Certification & GitHub Code Starter Distribution

eligibility: Open to all university students with basic familiarity with JavaScript or Python.
prerequisites: Personal laptop with Node.js 18+ or Python 3.10+ installed.

title: RoboVortex Arena: Combat Robotics Championship
shortDescription: High-voltage robot warfare where 15kg and 30kg combat bots battle for campus supremacy.
description: Witness sparks, pneumatic flips, and high-rpm drum spinners in the UNIVO Arena! Over 16 student-built combat robots battle in 1-on-1 knockout bouts inside our blast-proof polycarbonate cage. Cheering crowd, commentary, and technical teardowns after every bout.

agenda.title: Bot Weight Scrutiny, Fail-Safe Radio Test & Safety Briefing
Grand Championship Final & Arena Destruction Match

eligibility: Open to all spectators and registered robot combat builders.
prerequisites: Safety goggles provided at the entrance. Valid student ID required.

title: UNIVO E-Summit 2026: Future of Tech Startups
shortDescription: Keynotes from unicorn founders, venture capital panel debates, and early-stage startup networking expo.
description: The flagship annual entrepreneurship conclave of UNIVO. Connect directly with angel investors, seed-fund VCs, and successful student startup alumni. Featuring interactive panels on building defensible AI products, navigating regulatory landscapes, and pitching for institutional seed money.

agenda.title: Inauguration & Keynote Address by Unicorn Founder
VC Panel: Where is Venture Capital Investing in 2026?
Networking Buffet Lunch & Campus Startup Expo

eligibility: Open to all undergraduate, graduate students, and alumni founders.

title: PitchTank: ₹2,00,000 Equity-Free Seed Grant Battle
shortDescription: Top 10 shortlisted student startups pitch live before angel investors for equity-free prototype grants.
description: Watch 10 student startups take the stage in a high-stakes 5-minute pitch followed by 5 minutes of probing Q&A from prominent angel investors. Grants of ₹1,00,000, ₹60,000, and ₹40,000 will be awarded on the spot.
eligibility: Audience seats open to all students; pitching slots reserved for shortlisted teams.
prerequisites: Notebook and questions for the founders during open networking.

title: Aura 2026: Annual Inter-University Cultural Fest
shortDescription: UNIVO's biggest night of celebration featuring fusion live bands, celebrity concerts, and dance showcases.
description: The landmark cultural evening of the academic calendar! Aura brings 600+ students together under the campus stars for an unforgettable night of musical ensembles, thrilling choreography from Natraj Dance Troupe, street food stalls, and an electrifying headline band performance.

agenda.title: Gates Open & Campus Street Food Carnival
Classical & Western Fusion Ensemble by Dhwani
Mudra: Thematic Dance Showcase by Natraj

eligibility: All UNIVO students and faculty. Mandatory digital pass registration.
prerequisites: Must carry valid University ID card alongside digital registration pass.
coordinator: Prof. Suniti Rao & Dr. Ananya Sen

title: UNIVO Premier League: Football Finals 2026
shortDescription: CSE Tech Ninjas battle the Mechanical Spartans in the championship match of the UNIVO Football League.
description: After 4 weeks of intense group stage battles across 8 engineering branches, the two top teams clash under stadium floodlights for the coveted UNIVO Golden Cup. Free fan jerseys for the first 100 arrivals, live commentary, and halftime performances.

agenda.title: Stadium Gates Open & Fan Zone Warmup
Halftime Show by Natraj Hip-Hop Crew

eligibility: Open to all university students, staff, and faculty supporters.
prerequisites: Comfortable footwear. Stand seating is first-come, first-served.
coordinator: Coach Harpreet Singh (Directorate of Physical Education)

title: Raktadan Mahadan: Annual Red Cross Blood Camp
shortDescription: Voluntary blood donation camp conducted in partnership with the Indian Red Cross Society.
description: Every single blood donation can save up to 3 precious lives. Join Sparsh and government certified hematologists for our biannual humanitarian drive. Includes pre-donation health checkups, hemoglobin tests, juice and fruit refreshments, and government donor certificates.
eligibility: Healthy volunteers aged 18+, body weight 45kg+, Hb > 12.5 g/dL.
prerequisites: Ensure adequate hydration and a light breakfast before donating.

title: Echoes: Acoustic Rock & Indie Battle of the Bands
shortDescription: An electric evening of live indie rock, blues, and alternative music with 8 competing bands.
description: UNIVO's flagship music competition saw 8 powerhouse collegiate bands perform original compositions and tribute sets. Over 200 passionate music lovers packed Tagore Auditorium as 'The Red Shift' took home the 2026 Golden Plectrum Trophy.

agenda.title: Acoustic Solo Intermission by Dr. Ananya Sen

title: EcoClean: Campus Lake & Green Belt Rejuvenation
shortDescription: Cleanliness and tree plantation drive celebrating Gandhi Jayanti with 100+ student volunteers.
description: On the occasion of Gandhi Jayanti, 100 dedicated student volunteers partnered with the municipal green board to clean up the campus water catchment basin, removing 450+ kg of plastic trash and planting 120 indigenous trees along the perimeter.

agenda.title: Safety Briefing, Gloves & Bin Bag Distribution
